Name: Watch events Gain friends
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Watch events and gain 2 hearts with the NPC. You can choose which events you want to include. If you skip the event, you will not get the friendship points. There are some dialogue changes the events, but mostly it's just a cheat way to gain friendship.


Adopt a pet: 2 hearts with Marnie
Bats or Mushrooms: 2 hearts with Demetrius
Fishing Rod: 2 hearts with Willy
Forest Sewer: 2 hearts with Jas and Vincent
Found Cloth: 2 hearts with Emily
Found Copper: 2 hearts with Clint
Forest Sewer: 2 hearts with Jas and Vincent
Garden Pot: 2 hearts with Evelyn
Grandpa's Evaluation: 2 hearts with Linus, Harry and Pam. (You must know the NPC or you will not get the friendship boost.
Intro: 2 hearts with Robin and Lewis
Kent says Hello: 2 hearts with Kent and Jodi
Meet Wizard: 2 hearts with Wizard
Pierre seeds: 2 hearts with Pierre
Sewer Krobus and Dwarf fight: 2 hearts with Krobus and Dwarf 
Sunroom Tea: 2 hearts with Caroline
Trash: 2 hearts with Linus and Gus

I hope you enjoy the mod and take a look at my other mods.
